name: @cinatra-ai/contact-discovery-agent
description: Stateless leaf agent that takes an accountId and discovers contacts for that company. Apollo people-search primary path (when apolloFirst=true and Apollo connected); web_search via LinkedIn fallback. Persists each contact via crm_contact_create through the crm_* facade (a plain create — no server-side dedup, so repeated runs may create duplicates; cleanup/dedup is outside this leaf agent). Requires an email / linkedinUrl / apolloPersonId identity key per result.
